desc:
💥 Smash statues, vases, chandeliers, chess sets and organ pipes with real physics, so no two breaks look the same.

♾️ THE INFINITE MUSEUM
New wings and weapons are being added all the time, so check back in to see what's new!

🔨 OVER 25 WEAPONS
Earn money for every piece of property you destroy and spend it on pistols, shotguns, a sledgehammer, a laser cutter, grenades, a singularity, a nuke ☢️, and more!

🔍 SECRETS
Every wing hides a secret weapon. Can you find them all? 

🏆 CLIMB THE BOARDS
Break the most glass and spend the most time in the halls to climb the leaderboards!

⭐ Join our group to unlock a members' reward in Reception.

---

Roblox Premium members get access to the "Force Push" weapon for free!
